digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: A 429 HTTP response with Retry-After header must be retried on opted-in idempotent reads with jitter (up to 20%) applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S
The retry opt-in parameter must default to False on _with_connection_retry, _call_logged, and _paged_search to prevent unintended retry inheritance by future mutations
The Retry-After retry path must reach all four high-volume read call sites: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map (both _paged_search and per-issue fetch), and get_parent_map

All mutation call sites (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, transition_issue_by_name, set_relationship, delete_issue, delete_issue_link, set_parent) must fail immediately on first 429 without retry to prevent duplicate writes
A 429 response must raise BackendHTTPError with code 429 at the adapter boundary; JIRAError must never escape to the core
Absence of Retry-After header must degrade gracefully to existing behavior without retry, supporting pre-8.6 Jira and disabled limiters
